notes: Federal Defined Benefit Pension (Pre-1 July 2024): Gross pension = (Last Basic Pay * Service Years * 7) / 300 (up to 70% max).
Commutation capped at 35% of gross pension.

Minimum pension Rs. 12,000/month and minimum family pension Rs. 9,000/month w.e.f. 01-07-2023 per Finance Division OM No.F.15(1)-Reg.6/2023 dated 05-07-2023; the floor applies to gross pension and the top-up is non-commutable.
Provincial minimum floors follow the federal pattern - verify against the provincial finance department notification.
Federal post-July 2024 hires are covered under FGDC Defined Contribution Scheme (10% employee + 12% government contribution).

Family pension reform (OM F.No.9(3)R-6/2024-264 dated 10-09-2024): widow/widower retains family pension for LIFE; after the spouse, remaining eligible family members receive it for 10 years (disabled children: lifetime; other children: 10 years or till age 21, whichever is later).
Punjab Cabinet Notification (July 2026): Restored lifetime family pension for surviving widows and unmarried/divorced daughters.
Commutation capped at 35% with restoration after completion of commutation purchase period.
Sindh Civil Servants Pension Rules maintain classic Defined Benefit structure with lifetime family pension admissibility.
KPK Pension Reforms: Voluntary retirement eligibility is 25 qualifying service years with early retirement age restrictions.
